metadata.all_action_ntp: actions do not affect the process
metadata.belief_conditioning: visible tokens and preceding executed actions only; never rewards or hidden states
metadata.fit_protocol: training-only whole-episode SVD cross-validation; independent test rollouts
metadata.matched_pair_protocol: disjoint held-out pairs in different episodes with identical visible suffix; no belief-based selection
metadata.ntp_baselines: ntp/log_ntp use the target factor marginal; joint_ntp/log_joint_ntp use the full four-token distribution
metadata.ntp_timing: currently hidden token being guessed, from delayed source posterior
metadata.null_interpretation: descriptive controls, not exchangeability-based significance tests
metadata.suffix_prior: model reset prior; uniform, not an assumed policy-stationary prior
metadata.uncertainty: paired episode bootstrap with fixed fitted probes; not training-seed uncertainty

scope_warning: Linear accessibility is not causal use. Small bootstrap intervals do not establish model-seed generality; multiple layer/control comparisons are descriptive.
